name: Create a new compute cluster
description: Creates a new entry in the proxy server for a Kubernetes cluster.

name: Read info about compute clusters
description: Allows user to see details of a computer cluster in the system.

name: Deletes a compute cluster
description: Allows user to delete all information about a cluster from the server.

name: Read devices serial numbers
description: Allows user to look up a serial number array for a panel.

name: Read test information
description: Allows user to list available tests in a cluster, as well as test metadata.

name: Execute test
description: Allows user to start a test execution.

name: Stops test exection
description: Allows user to stop a test execution.

name: Create a kubernetes deployment for cluster
description: Allows user to create a new deployment entry in the server.

name: Read info about a kubernetes deployment
description: Allows user or cluster to list and view kubernetes deployments.

name: Apply a kubernetes deployment to a cluster
description: Allows user to override and apply a custom kubernetes deployment to a cluster.

name: Update a currently deployed kubernetes deployment
description: Allows the user to modify a deployment without deleting it and re applying it.

name: Deletes a kubernetes deployment
description: Allows user to delete a deployment from a cluster. An active deployment cant be deleted.

name: Read test execution results
description: Allows the user to list and view test executions results and metadata.

name: Delete test executions results
description: Allows the user to delete execution results from. This operation is non reversible.
